name: Ivan Kovačić
bio:
Ivan's fascination with engines began early, tinkering with his grandfather's old tractor in the Croatian countryside. This hands-on experience fueled his passion, leading him to pursue vocational training in machining. He quickly excelled, demonstrating a natural aptitude for precision and problem-solving. Eager to apply his skills in a high-pressure environment, Ivan joined Hot Car Competições, drawn to their commitment to innovation and competitive spirit.

At Hot Car Competições, Ivan is responsible for the fabrication and maintenance of crucial engine components. He is known for his meticulous attention to detail, ensuring that every part meets exacting standards. He thrives on the challenge of pushing the limits of performance, constantly seeking ways to improve the efficiency and reliability of the team's machinery. His colleagues appreciate his willingness to share his knowledge and contribute to a positive team environment.

What sets Ivan apart is his ability to diagnose and rectify intricate mechanical issues quickly and efficiently. He has a remarkable talent for visualizing the inner workings of complex systems, allowing him to identify potential problems before they arise. His dedication and proactive approach make him a valuable asset to the team, contributing significantly to their pursuit of success on the track.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight fade on the sides
physical.description: Ivan is of average height with a lean, athletic build.

quirks: Always sharpens his pencils to a perfect point before starting any task.
Has a habit of humming quietly while working on intricate parts.
Insists on cleaning his workspace thoroughly at the end of each day.
